metadata.title: On ruled normal surfaces associated with rectifying curves
metadata.abstract: In this paper we study the geometrical entities as Gauss and mean curvatures attached to the ruled normal surfaces associated with rectifying curves. A particular and special example of rectifying curves is also investigated, via its attached ruled normal surface. Our main result is the proof of the non-existence of rectifying curves that are simultaneously Bertrand curves.
